description: A markdown table in a reply or message: a bordered grid with a shaded header row, cells that wrap when long, and sideways scrolling when it is wider than the chat column.

parts.name: frame
parts.shows: 1px border in the rule colour (baude.rule), 8px corners, left-aligned, only as wide as its columns need, 2px above and below.

parts.name: header row
parts.shows: The first row: bold, on the raised fill (baude.raised), 5px/12px padding, a 1px rule under it.

parts.name: cells
parts.shows: 4px/12px padding, a faint rule (rule colour at 50%) under each row, text top-aligned with inline markdown (code, bold, links). The |---| alignment row is not shown. A row with fewer cells than the widest row gets empty cells.

parts.name: long cells
parts.shows: Short columns keep their natural width on one line; columns with cells longer than 40 characters share the rest of the chat's width and wrap, never narrower than 40 characters. Refitted as the window is resized.

parts.name: sideways scroll
parts.shows: When the table can't fit even so, it scrolls horizontally inside its own frame (horizontal scrollbar under it) instead of squashing the columns.

actions.does: Moves the table left and right.

states.name: small
states.shows: Inline with the text, as wide as its content.

states.name: tall
states.shows: Every row is drawn; the chat itself scrolls (no inner vertical scroll).
